text:
mike: heads-up — running an int8 canary for raven-v3 on the tool-calling path. parse failures spiked to ~0.8% vs ~0.02% on fp16. repro + logs below, cc @eva @carmen

eval-bot: canary summary: runs=10000, parse_fail_rate=0.008, avg_latency_ms=212, stderr_rate=0.0012

mike: repro prompt (trimmed) and the raw model output we saw:
```
PROMPT: invoke_tool: {"tool":"open_file","path":"/etc/hosts"}\nRESPONSE: {"action":"open_file","path":"/etc/hosts",}
```

mike: note trailing comma and occasionally an inline "\u0000" or cut token between `"path"` and `}`. appears when streaming chunks align with JSON end.

eva: is it truncation (incomplete JSON) or bad tokens inserted? can you attach raw tokenized output?

mike: attaching short sample (tokens separated by |):
```
... "path" : "/etc/hosts" | , | }
... "path" : "/tmp/sess-1" | \u0000 | }
```

dmitri: sounds like decode boundary artifacts from the quantized decoder kernel. we saw similar when the continuous-batching / kvcache coalesce didn't flush trailing token buffers. quant kernels sometimes produce a null byte when a codepath returns early.

sam: do we have runtime version and kernel flags for the canary?

mike: runtime=redwood-runtime/1.12.0-quant, compile flags: --fast-decode --streaming-enabled --kv-coalesce=auto

carmen: we had a hotfix for a stream-coalesce bug in 1.12.4 that fixed json truncation for int8 on some models. not sure if raven-v3 was covered.

eva: mitigation plan: 1) add a short postprocess step that waits for a matching closing brace when streaming and delays emit by up to 120ms if JSON seems open; 2) add a schema-validation retry: if parse fails, retry generation with fp16 fallback or a non-streaming call; 3) add telemetry to surface per-route parse_fail and fallback_rate.

mike: starting with (2) + telemetry. will flip postprocess after we confirm no perf regression. kicking canary with fallback policy (retry->fp16) now. deploy-bot, trigger canary patch?

deploy-bot: requested canary deploy started at 2168501012. image: raven-v3:int8-canary-fallback-20260320, rollout shard=1%

mike: running smoke: 5k calls in shard 1, will report parse rates in ~30m.

eva: also add a new eval harness test: run 2k structured-output prompts with quant seeds and assert parse_fail_rate <0.1%. add to nightly.

dmitri: long-term: fix the kernel path that emits stray 0x00 on early returns and ensure decoder coalesce when streaming-enabled. filing ticket.

sam: thanks. any immediate customer-facing risk?

mike: current shard small; fallback to fp16 should be seamless for callers. logging indicates no functional regressions except increased retries for some calls.

carmen: good. once we have telemetry from console we can decide whether to rollback or increase fallback percentage.

mike: will post updates. thx all :thumbsup:
